newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT 0.2 PCT DOWN IN OCTOBER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT 0.2 PCT DOWN IN OCTOBER.

text.p: Industrial output in Romania
fell by 0.2 percent in October from the previous month, after a
9.7 percent surge in September, National Statistics Board (CNS)
data showed.
ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT OCT 96 SEPT 96 OCT 95
pct change mth/mth -0.2 +9.7 +1.0
pct change yr/yr +9.2 +10.5 +10.7
share going to inventories 60.6 68.5 65.8
NOTE: Figures adjusted by the number of working days.
Over January-October, industry grew by 8.7 percent from the
same period in 1995, on the back of rises in the manufacturing
industry and the power sector of 11.6 and 4.0 percent
respectively. The extractive industry saw a 0.6 percent drop.
The CNS said 10-month industrial output was 55.4 trillion
lei, with 19.2 percent going to export.
CNS data showed around 60.6 percent of October's output
were inventories, compared with 68.5 percent in September.
Productivity per hour fell by 1.3 percent last month from
September, but rose 11.2 percent percent year-on-year.
Industry employed 2.22 million people at end-October, 2,300
less than the previous month.
-- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
